input.summary: Extend Deliverable warranty to 90 days and remove the remedy cut-off
input.comment: [Playbook] Fifteen days is too short and the "no correction or refund obligation" cut-off would strip the remedy in Section 19.4; we have moved to the market-standard ninety-day Deliverable warranty with the Section 19.4 remedies preserved.

ops.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
ops.newText: For ninety days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation, and Customer's remedies for nonconformity are as set out in Section 19.4.

input.summary: Limit take-or-pay to current 12-month term, reducible, with true-up
input.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept multi-year take-or-pay with no reduction or termination right, particularly as it conflicts with our convenience-termination right in Section 9.4 and Section 12.3. We have narrowed the commitment to the current twelve-month term, reducible on thirty days' notice, with a true-up rather than a penalty.

ops.oldText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services during the current twelve-month term, which commitment Customer may reduce on thirty days' written notice and which is settled by a true-up of any shortfall rather than a penalty. The commitment does not limit Customer's termination rights under Section 9.
